findings: Current local default artifact recipe names DrawPanel-debug.aar; current source modules reference drawpanellibv2. No Gradle resolution or installed App equivalence verified.
setAlignment compares LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT enum ordinals and calls TextView.setGravity with 3/1/5 respectively.
setRowSpace calls TextView.setLineSpacing(0f, rowSpace / 10f); it is a multiplier, not a raw point-valued line gap.

setTextViewSpan iterates the supplied list and checks nonnegative start/end and end <= Editable.length before type dispatch. This does not establish overlap precedence or invalid-range runtime outcome.
decision: Preserve alignment and row-space as distinct semantics; never map rowSpace directly to logical point gap. Runtime overlap/old instance fidelity still requires actual Android consumers.
scope: Static bytecode of this exact local AAR only, independent of other drawpanel sources. No source/AAR equivalence, APK, Android execution, user-note sample or migration acceptance. Source/AAR read-only; extracted jar and javap kept in Core build, not committed.
